audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 4 (Level 6) and 6 (2+ items) read "Skill" in both layers while their whys plainly describe Lillia winning (Lullaby cashes a kill window; Liandry's/Riftmaker out-chunks an enchanter frame). The already-audited mirror karma__lillia set those two rows to Lillia.
audit.why: The mirror is authoritative here and the whys on this page agree with it; leaving "Skill" renders a row that contradicts its own explanation.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side and win[4] -> Lillia; phases[6].side and win[6] -> Lillia. Rows 0-2 stay Karma, rows 3 and 5 stay Skill, matching the mirror.

audit.why: Spike structure is complete (4 entries) and the timings are right: Karma owns 1-3 on Mantra-Q range, Lillia's spike is level 6 with Lilting Lullaby (R 150/130/110s) conditional on Dream Dust already being applied, and first-item percent-HP burn is the equaliser.
audit.corrected: No change; the Dream Dust pre-condition on R is already stated in spikes[1].text and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeats "break it with range or line of sight" without ever giving Focused Resolve's cooldown (12s flat at every rank) and never mentions Mantra at all — 40/38/36/34s, and Karma's passive (Gathering Fire) shortens it every time a damaging ability lands, so the RQ poke the page warns about comes back faster the more she farms.
audit.why: These are the two numbers that make the advice actionable: the 12s tether cooldown is the trade window, and Mantra's self-accelerating cooldown explains why the poke never stops.
audit.corrected: Cooldown row now states 12s flat for the tether and Mantra 40s shortened by every spell she lands; dosFull[0].d gives the 12s window and names passive speed as the tether-break tool.
sources: enemyKit P text "damaging abilities will reduce the cooldown of Mantra"

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer refers to Karma as "he/his/him" in tldr, winCon, enemyWin, tradeGood and several dosFull/report bodies while the content layer correctly says "her".
audit.why: Same page, two genders for the same champion.
audit.corrected: Fixed in the strings edited here; the remaining ones need a champion-wide pronoun sweep (see notes).

edits.before: - Karma Focused Resolve (Tether): matchup-defining — The root tether — break it with range or line of sight. Count it out loud if you must. - Your passive move speed has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Karma Focused Resolve (Tether): matchup-defining — 12s, roots only if unbroken; range or sight cuts it. Mantra: 40s, cut further by every spell she lands. - Your passive move speed has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.

notes: Pronoun defect is champion-wide on the full layer for this matchup: enemyWin, tradeBad, ahead, breakdown.early/mid/wave/trading/feeding, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d and report[0]/[3]/[5] still say 'he/his/him' about Karma. I fixed the ones I was already editing rather than filing a dozen cosmetic-only edits — a pronoun sweep script would be cheaper. Ratings on rows 4 and 6 were 4/10 here and also 4/10 on Karma's side after the mirror audit, which cannot both be right — the convention is inverse (confirmed by the ksante and kled pairs, where the mirror's numbers invert to 10 minus x on this side). Rows 4 and 6 are therefore proposed at 6/10, inside the same chart group as the side flips.
